data.name: Younger glacial drift
data.descrip: Till.  Hard, blue-gray to gray concrete-like mixture of clay, silt, sand, and gravel deposited as end or recessional moraine.  Principally Wisconsin in age.
data.comments: Vashon drift (moraine and till members); Sumas Drift (in part); Possibly some outwash from the Fraser Glaciation (which encompassed the Vashon and Sumas Stades) occurs in this unit; most of it, however, is mapped within WAQg1o. Original map source: Raines, Gary L., and Johnson, Bruce R., 1996, Digital representation of the Washington state geologic map; a contribution to the Interior Columbia River basin ecosystem management project, U.S. Geological Survey Open-file report 95-0684, 20 p., plus digi. Primary reference: Jones, M.A., 1999, Geologic Framework for the Puget Sound Aquifer System, Washington and British Columbia: U. S. Geological Survey Professional Paper 1424-C, 31 p., 18 pls.

data.name: mostly Vashon Stade in western WA; unnamed in eastern WA
